novelty_search.nearest_result: The projected response-factor audit measured each frozen writer separately and found asymmetric off-task controllability/observability; no run has installed both independently computed upstream programs together.
novelty_search.new_question: Do the released q_has and q_is read-compute-write programs compose predictably and preserve each task when their writes are installed simultaneously?

frozen_operator.source_state: donor for P and base otherwise, matching each released program
frozen_operator.reads: Both released programs independently read their own fixed token contrast from the same source resid:10 state.
frozen_operator.scoring: For each population, score its native output pair under base, own-only, partner-only, and joint writes using the exact RMS-normalized soft-capped head.
forbidden: using donor or outcome values to choose alpha

bars.joint_A: Within each population, A1 and A2 joint mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.joint_P: Within each population, joint P mean reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.joint_C: Within each population, joint C mean normalized unrelated effect <=0.20.
bars.additive_law: For each population and family, mean absolute [joint delta - own delta - partner delta] / native target scale <=0.20.
bars.partner_surcharge: For each population and family, mean absolute joint-minus-own margin / native target scale <=0.50. This allows the already observed partial q_has-to-is/was response but rejects domination.
bars.own_route_replay: Own-only family metrics reproduce their immutable prospective receipts within 1e-5.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_basis_and_ex: All hashes, program releases, population capability, basis reconstructions, and exact local/final heads pass.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_dual_program_identity_and_: Both alphas exactly use the released programs with no forbidden inputs, and own-only route metrics replay within 1e-5.
predictions.pred_c_joint_has_had_program_preservatio: The has/had population passes joint A1/A2/P/C bars.
predictions.pred_d_joint_is_was_program_preservation: The is/was population passes joint A1/A2/P/C bars.
predictions.pred_e_additive_composition_and_bounded_: Every population/family passes the additive-law and partner-surcharge bars.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: 128 unique rows are measured in exactly four model forwards/256 examples, with eight inherited gain scalars, two 1,152-vectors, and zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the two bounded upstream programs compose predictably under simultaneous installation.
terminal.null: Authority, identity, replay, and coverage pass but joint preservation or additive composition misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, basis, exact head, frozen-program identity, own-route replay, or coverage fails.
